_doc: The court (GDD 4.12.5, 4.8, 4.12.1, ap. A; docs/contratos/h11_tribunal.md) [balance]. charges: what one can be tried for and its severity (the GDD table's examples). sentences: what each severity costs (fine range in gold, ledger justice; confiscation = the goods of the implicated business's storage, until H6 brings property; office_loss = the office and one title down; banishment = banishment_days days out of the town) and its reputation. facts: the charge of each kind of fact (inspection: by the Secrets upgrade found: smuggling with illegal_profit, else tax_evasion). trial: witnesses [min, max]; disposition_band (relation with the accused minus relation with the accuser >= band: favor, <= -band: against); prep_days (1 season), hearing_hours; proofs of each source; the formula of ap. A; town_rhetoric (the town accuses with it when nobody holds the inspector's office); keep: closed trials kept. witness_actions: convince (rhetoric vs empathy), bribe (gold_base + gold_per_negotiation x the witness's negotiation; favor for sure; stealth vs empathy, a failure is a denunciation: extra charge), threaten (martial vs martial; failure: against and extra charge). cross: questioning a witness against at the hearing (rhetoric vs empathy): success it does not count, failure it counts double. accuse: the title to accuse; fabricating proofs (stealth vs target; failure: reputation and a fact against the accuser); false_reputation: the accuser of a fabricated case that ends innocent. judge: a verdict against the scale costs honesty and risks a scandal (stealth vs target). honesty: the attitude changes (GDD 4.2.3: manipulating trials -20; the rest provisional).
